## Where it fits

Pick one (helps the maintainer route this):

- [ ] A new **functional unit** in `flybrain-connectome-mcp/functional_units.py`
- [ ] A new **connection type** in `CONNECTION_TYPES`
- [ ] A new **motif** in `flybrain-connectome-mcp/motifs/`
- [ ] A new **port type** in `PORT_TYPES`
- [ ] A new **gate** in `scripts/check_*.py`
- [ ] New **data source** (a fourth connectome? which?)
- [ ] Documentation / examples only
